_notes: The indexed-repository stand-in for the promotion corpus's diversity arm.
This is the code-side half of the CORPUS, not a stand-in for any part of
the truth core: it supplies the rows a completed index run would have left
behind (repositories + code_files + code_edges), and every assertion, fact,
provenance row and ladder decision downstream of it is produced by shipped
code -- code_deriver.assert_repo_graph, fact_lift.run_code_lift,
verification_recompute.run_recompute. Writing these three tables by hand is
the same act as writing the memory corpus by hand; what may not be written
by hand is what the ladder reads to decide, and nothing here is.
The imports are all real, published Python packages, none of which is a
stdlib module or a suffix of an indexed file path -- the two conditions
code_deriver.dependency_name / is_internal_import decline on.
EDITING CONSTRAINT: this file is half of the corpus's diversity design.
Every `diversity` claim in corpus.json is seconded by exactly one import
edge here, so removing or renaming a target_key removes that claim's
second origin -- it would still load and run, and would silently hold at
one origin outside the diversity bucket. Both directions are checked by
promotion_corpus.validate_diversity_group_against_fixture; edit the claim
and its import together. An import no claim mentions is allowed: it mints
a code-only fact born on the rung, which the completeness probe counts as
a carve-out rather than losing.
